== Strategy ==

This is my first attempt at this type of deck, so go easy.  I favored the EndorOps start because it just seems to be much better.  I only have the two Scythe TIEs because I expect that the rest of my ships can hold space plus the TIEs can shoot people fairly effectively in the DS2.  I don't choose Double Efforts as my effect starter because with two Accelerates and as slow as it takes me to get set up, I should have Double Efforts in hand by the time I'm ready to get out and about.  I have Arica in here to block a ground drain and the EPP Vaders, Emperor and Walkers make a surprisingly strong ground force.  Maul is for ground also, but if you need to hold off some space drains against wussy pilots, stick him on his ship and watch the pilots cower in fear.  Against heavy ground decks, use your EPP Vaders and walkers sparingly.  Try to pick the weakest spot and hit them there, or just try to hold a site.  Move the DS2 to the system they're at if it's on table, otherwise just take it to another system and sit there and drain/cause direct damage.  Against heavy space decks...this is going to be a tougher matchup because of the threat of blowing away the DS2.  Get the Scythes ready for some action but don't send them out unless you have to, keep them near the DS2.  Let the admirals in the destroyers take care of most of the space.  If necessary you can even put Vader and Mara in space and use the walkers as forfeit bate.  You should be able to win any slugfest if you group together.  Be mindful of the Super Falcon as it can really screw even the Executor.  I'd like to maybe fit some more space power in here plus the AO We're in Attack Position for my cap ships, but I can't think of anything to throw out.  Any help would be great with this...I'd like to see if I can improve upon it any.  Thanks for looking.
